thread:
alex: quick sync — thinking we need a small state machine for SLO thresholds that plays nicely with per-tenant rate caps and notify routing. spam from bursts is killing oncall noise. suggestions?
maria: +1. can you outline what states you mean? also how does tenant rate cap interact — block vs degrade? :eyes:
alex: rough idea: OK -> WARN -> VIOLATED -> QUIET_BACKOFF -> RECOVERED. on VIOLATED we trigger normal notify routing; after N alerts in M minutes for the same tenant we move to QUIET_BACKOFF and switch to sampling/fallback routes. QUIET_BACKOFF still records telemetry but suppresses fanout. would surface suppressed counts in console.
sam: agree with state approach. tenant rate caps should be a separate guardrail that can short-circuit fanout early (ie. if cap reached, mark events as "cap_tripped" and route to low-volume channel). that way quota != SLO state but influences routing.
jia: important: we must keep full fidelity telemetry for suppressed events. UI should let you drill into suppressed alerts (timestamps + sample traces) so quality teams can debug. also add tags: tenant_id, route_id, slo_id, suppression_reason.
leo: UX note — console rollout needs a clear affordance: "suppressed X alerts (view)" and a per-tenant toggle for suppression visibility. canary the suppression rules for e.g., 5% of tenants first.
maria: what about override precedence? e.g., Dedicated customers want no suppression or different thresholds. we need policy order: customer_override > product_plan > global_default.
alex: yeah precedence like that. thinking API shape for SLO evaluation service: POST /internal/v1/slo-eval { tenant, route, metric, window } -> { state, reason, notify_routes:[], suppression_hint }. sample state payload:```json
{"state":"VIOLATED","backoff_until":"2026-05-01T17:30:00Z","suppression_reason":"burst_quota","notify_routes":["pager","email-sampled"]}
```
alert-bot: Deploy: slo-eval-service v2.3.1 promoted to staging — smoke tests passing :rocket:
sam: edgecases: flapping tenants that oscillate around threshold. add min_hold (eg 5m) before state transitions and exponential backoff on QUIET_BACKOFF to avoid oscillation. also cap total suppressed-per-tenant/day so we can surface behavioral signals.
jia: telemetry ingest: please ensure suppressed events get a flag `suppressed:true` and full context in raw store (not just summary). that'll let offline evals and alerts-on-analytics.
leo: rollout plan proposal: 1) feature flag for suppression engine, 2) console visibility toggles, 3) canary to 5% tenants, 4) collect noise metrics for 48h, 5) widen. add CTA in console to "replay suppressed" for a tenant.
maria: I want clear admin override in console to force-disable suppression per-tenant for Dedicated customers. default should be "on" for Hosted.
alex: action items: sam add cap short-circuit PR for rate caps; jia add telemetry schema + ingestion checklist; leo prototype console badge + "replay suppressed" CTA; maria write precedence doc for overrides. I'll draft state machine RFC this afternoon and link here. :thumbsup:
maria: sounds good, pls tag me in RFC.
leo: i'll drop a quick figma for the badge.
alert-bot: Note: SLO-eval scheduled job will run with new sampling flags in staging at 2026-04-01T08:00Z.
